title: Airpro Technology India IPO
summary: Airpro Technology India IPO is a ₹35.64 crore fixed-price issue priced at ₹99 per share, to be listed on NSE SME. It is open from November 27 to December 1, 2026, with allotment expected on December 2 and listing on December 4, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹2,37,600 for 2,400 shares.

Airpro Technology India Limited is involved in providing specialized engineering, manufacturing, and technology solutions in the industrial and infrastructure segments. Airpro Technology India Limited aims to provide high-quality products and services through the use of advanced technology and innovation. · · Product Range: · Wireless Access Points: Offer seamless wireless connectivity in indoor, outdoor, and dense environments. · WLAN Controllers: Helps manage, configure, and monitor multiple wireless access points from a central location. · Ethernet Switches: Connect network devices and transmit data efficiently in enterprise networks. · Gateways: Ensure secure communication and routing of data traffic between internal and external networks. · Outdoor Wireless Solutions: Offer wireless connectivity in campuses, industrial plants, and remote sites. · 4G/5G Customer Premises Equipment (CPE): Offer wireless broadband services where wired connectivity cannot be offered. · Industrial PoE Switches: Offer power supply as well as data transfer over a single Ethernet cable for IP cameras, access points, and industrial IoT devices.
Deepak Jain, Rajesh Hasmukh Vakharia, Pankaj Bhansali, Roopali Bhansali are the company's promoters of Airpro Technology India.
